title: Seismic Design Category C.
officialText: Where a structure is assigned to Seismic Design Category C in accordance with Section 1613, individual pile caps or piles shall be interconnected by ties. Ties shall be capable of carrying, in tension and compression, a force equal to the lesser of: (i) the product of the larger of the pile cap or column design gravity load times the seismic coefficient, S , divided by 10, or (ii) 25 percent of the smaller of the pile or column design gravity load, unless it can be demonstrated that DS equivalent restraint is provided by reinforced concrete beams within slabs on grade, reinforced concrete slabs on grade, or confine-ment by competent rock, hard cohesive soils or very dense granular soils.
